_comment: Generated by scripts/a40_constants.py from content/a40/constants.yaml. Do not edit; run `npm run constants`.

operating_mass.label: Operating mass (driver + full tank)
operating_mass.note: Sum of the mass table in build-constants. Corner-weigh when rolling.

driver_mass.note: Curb mass = operating mass minus the driver.

fuel_mass.note: Stock-size ~30-35 L tank, full. Verify the tank.

front_weight_fraction.note: Static front share. Estimate; corner-weigh once rolling.

unsprung_front.note: Per corner. Miata corner + 205/65R15 + half the arms.

unsprung_rear.note: Per corner. As the front plus half a half-shaft. Diff, subframe and inner half-shaft are sprung.

cg_height.note: Miata 460 mm + ~115 mm for the taller body and seating. Refine from CAD.

cg_height_tol.note: CG band used for sensitivity (525-625 mm).

cg_height_miata.note: Donor NA Miata CG height (published estimate).

wheelbase_miata.note: NA Miata (published). Sets the stock knuckle Ackermann angle.

front_track_miata.note: Donor NA front track at ET40. Published 1405-1425; 1420 matches the scan. Measure the donor hub-face width.

et_miata.note: NA Miata wheel offset (published). Hub face sits ET outboard of the wheel centreline.

front_narrowing.note: Every front inboard pickup moves this far inboard per side; hub face moves by the same amount.

hub_z_miata.note: Loaded hub-centre height on the donor (estimate used by the scrub/trail and RC model).

rear_track.note: Tyre CL to tyre CL, from the rear scan with the ET38 wheels.

rear_track_miata.note: Donor NA rear track as published. Measure hub face to hub face on the donor.

rear_et_miata_lo.note: If the published donor rear track is quoted at ET40.

rear_et_miata_hi.note: If the published donor rear track is quoted at ET45.

shock_angle.note: Front shock angle to the LCA at the lower mount. Sets the motion ratio; lock with the shock-tower position.

shock_stroke.note: 5 in stroke, until the shock is chosen.

shock_bump_fraction.note: Share of the stroke in bump at ride height (assumed, about the stock Miata split).

shock_length_ride.note: Eye-to-eye at ride height (assumed). Only affects how MR drifts through travel.

miata_wheel_travel_lo.note: Stock NA front wheel travel, bump + droop (70-75 + 85-90 mm), low end.

miata_wheel_travel_hi.note: Stock NA front wheel travel, high end.

ride_freq_front.note: Front ride frequency. Springs are specified as wheel rates from this.

ride_freq_rear.note: 0.1 Hz above the front so the body heaves flat instead of pitching.

rear_mr_lo.note: Rear motion ratio sensitivity case. Measure on the donor (shock travel vs wheel travel).

rear_rc_lo.note: Rear roll centre, low end of the assumed band. Model or measure the narrowed Miata rear.

rear_rc_nom.note: Rear roll centre used where one number is needed.

rear_rc_hi.note: Rear roll centre, high end of the assumed band.

lateral_accel.note: Load case for roll and weight transfer.

roll_target_lo.note: Body roll target at the load case, low end.

roll_target_nom.note: Body roll target used where one number is needed.

lltd_offset_lo.note: Start LLTD this far above the front static weight fraction.

lltd_offset_hi.note: Upper end of the LLTD start offset.

arb_ir_miata.note: ARB installation ratio on the Miata, back-calculated from "stock 19 mm bar adds ~10 kN·m/rad" (unsourced). Measure the end-link geometry.

road_input.note: Road bump amplitude for the front bump-travel budget (assumed).

caster_target_lo.note: Realistic caster target with about ±2° of adjustment from the scanned 3.62°.

caster_target_hi.note: Upper end of the caster target.

lock_loss_lo.note: Steering lock lost to body/tyre clearance vs the Miata, low end. Measure on the jig.

turning_circle_miata.note: NA Miata kerb-to-kerb turning circle (published, ~4.7 m radius).

final_drive.note: Stock RX-8 6-speed final drive. Verify on the unit bought; the ratio is an open decision.

final_drive_alt1.note: Alternative ratio for the rpm table.

final_drive_alt2.note: Alternative ratio for the rpm table.

gear_z32_top.note: Z32 5-speed 5th gear (published; 4th is 1:1). Verify on the unit if the Z32 is the one bought.

reference_speed.note: Cruise speed for the rpm table.

pinion_angle.note: RX-8 pinion nose-up, parallel to the gearbox.

shaft_drop.note: Driveshaft vertical drop, gearbox output to pinion. Measure on the jig.

shaft_length.note: Driveshaft centre-to-centre run. Measure on the jig.

sprung_mass.note: Operating mass minus four unsprung corners.

front_hub_face_miata.note: Donor hub face from CL = half-track + ET.

front_hub_face.note: Build reference plane: donor hub face − narrowing.

front_track_nominal.note: Front track rounded to 10 mm; used for vehicle-level ratios.

rack_narrowing.note: Same as the track change: 2 × narrowing.

hub_z.note: Donor hub height + half the OD increase.

tyre_poke.note: Per side, outside the stock A40 tyres (nominal track).

tyre_poke_rounding.note: Per-side poke difference between the exact and nominal track.

tyre_inner_shift.note: How much further inboard the inner tyre edge sits than stock.

rear_narrowing_lo.note: Donor rear hub face (ET40 case) − build hub face.

rear_narrowing_hi.note: Donor rear hub face (ET45 case) − build hub face.

spring_rear_lo.note: Rear wheel rate / MR² for this rear MR case.

spring_rear_mid.note: Rear wheel rate / MR² for this rear MR case.

spring_rear_hi.note: Rear wheel rate / MR² for this rear MR case.

roll_stiffness_front.note: Kw T²/2 at the nominal track.

rpm_fd_5th.note: Engine rpm at 100 km/h, 5th gear, final drive 4.44.

rpm_fd_6th.note: Engine rpm at 100 km/h, 6th gear, final drive 4.44.

rpm_fd_z32_top.note: Engine rpm at 100 km/h, z32_top gear, final drive 4.44.

rpm_alt1_5th.note: Engine rpm at 100 km/h, 5th gear, final drive 4.1.

rpm_alt1_6th.note: Engine rpm at 100 km/h, 6th gear, final drive 4.1.

rpm_alt1_z32_top.note: Engine rpm at 100 km/h, z32_top gear, final drive 4.1.

rpm_alt2_5th.note: Engine rpm at 100 km/h, 5th gear, final drive 3.91.

rpm_alt2_6th.note: Engine rpm at 100 km/h, 6th gear, final drive 3.91.

rpm_alt2_z32_top.note: Engine rpm at 100 km/h, z32_top gear, final drive 3.91.

ackermann_knuckle.note: Stock Miata arm angle atan(half-track / wheelbase).

damping_crit_front_damper.note: Critical damping at the damper: wheel value / MR².

travel_road_lo.note: Road input / (2ζ) at the high end of the ride damping band.

travel_road_hi.note: Road input / (2ζ) at the low end of the ride damping band.

travel_budget_lo.note: Roll travel at the nominal roll target + amplified road input.

travel_budget_hi.note: Roll travel at the nominal roll target + amplified road input.

uca_cant_half.note: Half the plan-cant offset: each UCA pivot sits this far either side of the pivot-line midpoint.

uca_pivot_front.note: Front UCA pivot from CL (midpoint + half the cant offset).

uca_pivot_rear.note: Rear UCA pivot from CL (midpoint − half the cant offset).

roll_arm_lo.note: CG height − roll-axis height (rear RC high end).

roll_arm_hi.note: CG height − roll-axis height (rear RC low end).

| Front narrowing | 95 mm per side | locked | Hub face moves from 750 to 655 mm from centreline. Rack cut 190 mm total. |
| Front track | ~1230 mm (1234 at ET38) | locked | Track = 2 × (hub face − ET). Stock A40 is 1232 mm. Donor baseline (1405 published vs 1420 used) is unverified: measure the donor hub faces. |
| Rear track | 1340 mm | locked | Narrowed Miata rear, hub face 708 mm from centreline. |
| Rear narrowing | ~42–47 mm per side | measure | Stock rear hub-face distance − 708 mm. See [rear suspension](./rear-suspension). |

| Tyre outer-to-outer (front) | ~1435 mm | working | 1230 + 205. Stock A40 is 1232 + 133 = 1365 mm, so the tyres sit **~35 mm/side** further out than stock (37 at the exact 1234 mm track). Main fitment risk; check against the body scan. See [narrowing analysis](./narrowing-analysis). |
